Was die Meldestelle leisten muss: What the reporting office must cover
Beschäftigungsgeber mit in der Regel min: Employers with at least 50 employees as a rule must establish an internal reporting office (§ 12(2) HinSchG); for entities listed in § 12(3), such as credit institutions, investment services firms, and insurance undertakings, this applies regardless of headcount. The office acknowledges receipt within seven days and provides feedback within three months of acknowledgment (§ 17). Reports must be possible in writing and orally, and upon request in person (§ 16(3)); this plugin covers the written channel only. Anonymous reports should be processed, though channels enabling them are not mandatory (§ 16(1)). Documentation must be deleted three years after closure (§ 11(5)); the plugin deletes nothing automatically. The plugin does not assess legal duties.

Nach § 11 Abs. 5 HinSchG ist die Dokumen: Under § 11(5) HinSchG, documentation is retained for three years after closure. By default, reports, messages, audit log, and key pair are preserved when deleting the plugin so updates or reinstallations do not destroy statutory records.

No later than seven days (§ 17(1) No. 1 HinSchG).
Innerhalb von drei Monaten nach der Eing: Within three months of acknowledgment, stating planned and taken follow-up measures (§ 17(2) HinSchG).
Meldung und Nachrichten werden auf dem S: Reports and messages are encrypted server-side with AES-256-GCM and the AES key is sealed with RSA. Where the RSA private key lives depends on wp-config.php: in wp-config.php via WM_HINSCHG_PRIVATE_KEY, encrypted in the database via WM_HINSCHG_KEY_PASSPHRASE, or in plaintext in legacy installs where a database dump decrypts every report. The active mode is shown at the top of this page and via wp hinschg key-status. Between browser and server, HTTPS protects transport.
Das Plugin prüft die eigene Berechtigung: The plugin checks its own capability wm_hinschg_read_cases and provides the role "Meldestelle (HinSchG)". WordPress roles or a role-manager plugin control who holds it, rather than a duplicate screen here. Administrators receive it on install to avoid lockout; revoking it afterward is the intended separation. wp hinschg access lists current holders.
Jeder Eintrag enthält einen HMAC-SHA256: Each entry carries an HMAC-SHA256 over its predecessor. Edits, deletions, and insertions are detected; anyone with access to the key in wp-config.php can re-sign the chain.
